narrative: The page has numerous accessibility violations, primarily concerning missing alt text for images, lack of discernible link text for navigation, and poor color contrast. Additionally, it fails to specify the page language and uses touch targets that are too small. These issues significantly hinder accessibility for users relying on assistive technologies.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.88 (foreground color: #41545d, background color: #a9b8bf, font size: 9.8pt (13px), font weight: bold). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: 'Free Penguins' and 'More City Parks' have low color contrast (3.88:1), failing the 4.5:1 requirement.
findings.suggested_fix: Increase the foreground color contrast against the background color.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The <html> element does not have a lang attribute
findings.note: The HTML document lacks a lang attribute on the <html> element, preventing screen readers from identifying the page's language.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a lang attribute to the <html> tag (e.g., lang="en").

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an alt attribute
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"
findings.note: Many images (decorations, icons) lack alt attributes, and some meaningful images do not have appropriate alternative text.
findings.suggested_fix: Add alt attributes to all elements. Use empty alt="" for decorative images and descriptive text for informative ones.

Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size (94px by 20px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 16px instead of at least 24px.

findings.suggested_fix: Increase the size of the clickable area to at least 24x24 CSS pixels.
